name: CERES dataset viewer
description: Public and authenticated replay for CERES recordings.

paragraphs: CERES dataset viewer replays and organises exported capture episodes directly from a Hugging Face dataset repository. Public datasets open without an account. Signing in adds access to private and gated datasets through the viewer's existing Hugging Face permissions.

The authoritative source lives in infrastructure/viewer/ of hcltech-robotics/ceres-dev. The Hugging Face Space is a deployment mirror and must not be edited directly. The initial source was imported from immutable Space revision 47cac523b9c15491564b78a14235dcb7b9d94afb. The complete provenance and materialised asset hashes are recorded in SOURCE-PROVENANCE.md and asset-manifest.json.
The landing page accepts any CERES repository as owner/name. chrisvoncsefalvay/ceres-demos is provided as the public example, and a repository can also be supplied through the repo query parameter.

requirements.text: Public datasets open without an account.

The package Playwright suite covers the public landing and replay route, the contextual sign-in path for restricted repositories, restoration of copy intent after sign-in, copy-only access and owner edit access.
